title: London NFL Games: The Revenue Hit Some Owners Are Happy to Take

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: London NFL Games: The Revenue Hit Some Owners Are Happy to Take
sources.description: LONDON—The Washington Commanders are technically “hosting” the Indianapolis Colts in London on Sunday, meaning the showdown at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium is replacing a game that the NFL team would otherwise have held at Northwest Stadium in Maryland. That creates a totally different set of economics. While NFL teams keep the bulk of the ticket revenue …
